LESSON: a hash pin over one repo's copy is an EDIT guard, not a divergence guard -- it cannot see the other repo move, and a stale copy can pass deliberately if a test asserts the stale state. Pair the pin with the other side's own BYTES at a named commit (and, to catch upstream movement, that side in CI).

LESSON: when the corpus remints verification states, teach the rank map the new state AND make unknown states a mismatch -- otherwise 'primary-source-verified -> transcription-read' compares as unknown-to-unknown and 98 real changes pass a test whose whole job is to catch them.
